subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 05 33 conduit routing between Electrical Detail 2/E502 and

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 05 33 conduit routing between One-Line Diagram E-002 and Electrical Detail 2/E502 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected. Please respond at your earliest convenience.

One-Line Diagram E-002 governs for the Section 26 05 33 conduit routing near LP-1; Electrical Detail 2/E502 will be superseded by an updated drawing. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected.
